subject: NovusTech — Security intake & buying path (recap)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@novustech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovusTech — Security intake & buying path (recap)

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap & proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Call highlights:
- Primary use: internal customer support assistant (LU and retrieval) across web and mobile.
- Expected initial QPS: ~5–10 reqs/sec, 90th pct latency target ~300ms per reply.
- Sensitive items: PII in transcripts; logs retention and export controls are must-haves.
- Decision timeline: procurement + security sign-off in ~4–6 weeks.
- Economic buyer: Sophie (you) and VP Product (TBD).

Open asks / actions (from Redwood):
1) Please share your security questionnaire document — we can fill or run through an evidence call (either works).
2) Confirm which systems are in scope (web app backend, support ZIP attachments, analytics pipeline, vendor integrations).
3) Procurement contact for SOW/PO and approximate cadence for legal review.
4) Any required certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) or encryption/KMS constraints.

Proposed next steps (if this works for you):
- You send the questionnaire and network diagram — we’ll return a completed intake within 3 business days.
- Schedule a 45-min security intake with our Solutions Engineer and your security lead (suggested window next week).
- Introduce procurement contact for pricing/terms flow.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (solutions) and Ben (account lead) so they can own the intake and pricing threads respectively.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@novustech.com>

Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovusTech — Security intake & buying path (recap)

Karthik — great summary, thanks. Attached is our standard Vendor Security Questionnaire and a network diagram that shows the systems we anticipate being in scope. A few immediate clarifications: 

- Primary systems in-scope: customer-facing web app (auth handled by our IDP), backend support microservice (hosts conversation logs), and S3 buckets that store attachments and transcripts.
- We will not include analytics event store in the initial scope; we may add it for phase 2.
- Certifications: SOC 2 Type II is required; ISO 27001 is nice-to-have but not mandatory for this phase.

Procurement contact: Evan Li (procurements@novustech.com) — he handles PO and contract routing. He should be on copy for any commercial/contract threads.

I’ve attached: 
- Novus_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (fillable)
- novustech_network_diagram_v0_3.pdf

We prefer a completed questionnaire first; follow that with a 30–45 min evidence call if you have any follow-up questions. We’re targeting procurement/legal review the week of June 14.

Thanks,
Sophie Kramer
Director, Product Operations, NovusTech
sophie.kramer@novustech.com

Attachments: Novus_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx, novustech_network_diagram_v0_3.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@novustech.com>, Evan Li <procurements@novustech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovusTech — Security intake & buying path (recap)

Thanks Sophie — received both files and we’ll start filling the questionnaire today. A couple notes from our side: 

- We can return the filled questionnaire within 48–72 hours. If any items need evidence (architecture screenshots, control-owner names, SOC 2 report), Marissa will propose a short evidence session.
- For KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations; if you require this we’ll flag it as a configuration item in the PO.
- Data residency: our hosted API offers region pinning to US or EU. For now I noted US.

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) — high level: 
1) 6 Jun: Redwood returns completed questionnaire + supporting docs.
2) 8–10 Jun: optional evidence call (Marissa + your security lead).
3) 14–18 Jun: procurement/legal review; Ben will engage on pricing and SOW.
4) Late Jun: pilot kickoff (subject to approvals).

Evan — looping you in to confirm PO cadence and any required purchase order templates. If you prefer, Ben can start a preliminary quote and SOW draft and we can route that to procurement once security items are OK.

Thanks — will push the filled questionnaire this Friday.

— Karthik
From: Evan Li <procurements@novustech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sophie Kramer <sophie.kramer@novustech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovusTech — Security intake & buying path (recap)

Hi all — thanks for the loop. Quick notes from procurement: 

- NovusTech uses a standard PO process. We require a commercial quote with an itemized line for monthly committed capacity (if any) and an estimated overage price.
- Lead time for legal review is usually 5–7 business days after we receive the SOW + redlines (we can expedite to 2–3 days for straightforward SaaS terms).
- Preferred billing: Net 30. We can accept e-invoices; please include the line-item pricing and Redwood TIN in the SOW.

I’ve attached our procurement intake form (one page) — fill and return and I’ll route internally.

Procurement contact: Evan Li
NovusTech Procurement
procurements@novustech.com

Attachment: novustech_procurement_intake.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: NovusTech intake — immediate playbook and owners

Marissa / Ben — quick internal summary and owners following the NovusTech intake: 

Summary: Sophie shared questionnaire + network diagram. Systems in initial scope: web app (IDP auth), support backend (conversation logs), S3 transcripts/attachments. SOC 2 Type II required. Procurement contact: Evan (procurements@novustech.com). Target procurement review window: week of Jun 14.

Actions: 
- Marissa: own questionnaire completion + evidence call scheduling. Target to return completed questionnaire by 2027-06-03 EOD PST. If you need the SOC 2 report or control screenshots I’ll get them from Compliance.
- Ben: prepare preliminary quote/SOW draft and a line-item for a pilot (monthly committed capacity + overage). Aim to have a draft by 2027-06-04 so Evan can start internal routing.
- Me: confirm KMS/residency options and flag customer-managed keys if required. I’ll also create the HubSpot deal (ND-2027-0893) and upload docs to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cnovus-qa-folder

Risks / notes:
- If SOC 2 report shows any gap, we’ll propose compensating controls + an evidence call.
- Pricing sensitivity for pilot; be conservative with overage estimates.

Let me know if anything else.

— Karthik
